connector.name: Vatnode MCP
connector.registryDescription: Official MCP server: EU VAT validation via VIES, plus offline rates and format checks.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vatnode-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vatnode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VATNODE_API_KEY
env.description: vatnode API key (free tier available at https://vatnode.dev). Required only for the validate_vat_number tool — the four other tools (rates, format checks, country list) work offline without a key.

env.name: VATNODE_API_URL
env.description: Override the vatnode API base URL (for self-hosting or staging environments). Defaults to https://api.vatnode.dev.
